Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA Emergency Action Plans Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38.
  • OSHA Fire Safety Training for Workplace Safety: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910 Subparts E and L.
  • OSHA Flammable and Combustible Liquids Awareness Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Standards 29 CFR 1910.106 and NFPA 30 Code.
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for Construction Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926 Subpart J and 2024 NFPA 51B Standard.
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for General Industry Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910 Subpart Q and 2024 NFPA 51B Standard.
  • OSHA Incipient Firefighting Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.157 and 29 CFR 1910.38.
How long does Fire Safety, Hot Work & Emergency Action Plan Training take?
  • OSHA Emergency Action Plans Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Fire Safety Training for Workplace Safety: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Flammable and Combustible Liquids Awareness Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for Construction Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for General Industry Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Incipient Firefighting Training: 2 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • OSHA Emergency Action Plans Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Fire Safety Training for Workplace Safety: valid 12 months
  • OSHA Flammable and Combustible Liquids Awareness Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for Construction Training: valid 24 months
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for General Industry Training: valid 24 months
  • OSHA Incipient Firefighting Training: valid 12 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • OSHA Emergency Action Plans Training
  • OSHA Fire Safety Training for Workplace Safety
  • OSHA Flammable and Combustible Liquids Awareness Training
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for Construction Training
  • OSHA Hot Work Safety for General Industry Training

The other course is in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
